title: Field
description: The wrapper every control deserves: a label, a hint, and an error that knows which input it belongs to.
usage: Wrap any single control in a Field so labels, hints and errors stay attached. Stack Fields with a consistent gap and a form stops looking improvised.
a11y: The label is a real <label>, the hint and error are wired with aria-describedby, and the error carries role="alert" only when it appears after submit — not while typing.
